// `C` will already be defined here.\n            //          static { ... }\n            //      };\n            //      return C;\n            //  })();\n\n            classExpression = factory.createClassExpression(/*modifiers*/ undefined, /*name*/ undefined, /*typeParameters*/ undefined, heritageClauses, members);\n            if (classInfo.classThis) {\n                classExpression = injectClassThisAssignmentIfMissing(factory, classExpression, classInfo.classThis);\n            }\n\n            const classReferenceDeclaration = factory.createVariableDeclaration(classReference, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, classExpression);\n            const classReferenceVarDeclList = factory.createVariableDeclarationList([classReferenceDeclaration]);\n            const returnExpr = classInfo.classThis ? factory.createAssignment(classReference, classInfo.classThis) : classReference;\n            classDefinitionStatements.push(\n                factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, classReferenceVarDeclList),\n                factory.createReturnStatement(returnExpr),\n            );\n        }\n        else {\n            // produces:\n            //  return <classExpression>;\n            classExpression = factory.createClassExpression(/*modifiers*/ undefined, node.name, /*typeParameters*/ undefined, heritageClauses, members);\n            classDefinitionStatements.push(factory.createReturnStatement(classExpression));\n        }\n\n        if (shouldTransformPrivateStaticElementsInClass) {\n            addInternalEmitFlags(classExpression, InternalEmitFlags.TransformPrivateStaticElements);\n            for (const member of classExpression.members) {\n                if ((isPrivateIdentifierClassElementDeclaration(member) || isAutoAccessorPropertyDeclaration(member)) && hasStaticModifier(member)) {\n                    addInternalEmitFlags(member, InternalEmitFlags.TransformPrivateStaticElements);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        setOriginalNode(classExpression, node);\n        return factory.createImmediatelyInvokedArrowFunction(factory.mergeLexicalEnvironment(classDefinitionStatements, lexicalEnvironment));\n    }\n\n    function isDecoratedClassLike(node: ClassLikeDeclaration) {\n        return classOrConstructorParameterIsDecorated(/*useLegacyDecorators*/ false, node) ||\n            childIsDecorated(/*useLegacyDecorators*/ false, node);\n    }\n\n    function visitClassDeclaration(node: ClassDeclaration): VisitResult<Statement> {\n        if (isDecoratedClassLike(node)) {\n            const statements: Statement[] = [];\n            const originalClass = getOriginalNode(node, isClassLike) ?? node;\n            const className = originalClass.name ? factory.createStringLiteralFromNode(originalClass.name) : factory.createStringLiteral(\"default\");\n            const isExport = hasSyntacticModifier(node, ModifierFlags.Export);\n            const isDefault = hasSyntacticModifier(node, ModifierFlags.Default);\n            if (!node.name) {\n                node = injectClassNamedEvaluationHelperBlockIfMissing(context, node, className);\n            }\n            if (isExport && isDefault) {\n                const iife = transformClassLike(node);\n                if (node.name) {\n                    //  let C = (() => { ... })();\n                    //  export default C;\n                    const varDecl = factory.createVariableDeclaration(factory.getLocalName(node), /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, iife);\n                    setOriginalNode(varDecl, node);\n\n                    const varDecls = factory.createVariableDeclarationList([varDecl], NodeFlags.Let);\n                    const varStatement = factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, varDecls);\n                    statements.push(varStatement);\n\n                    const exportStatement = factory.createExportDefault(factory.getDeclarationName(node));\n                    setOriginalNode(exportStatement, node);\n                    setCommentRange(exportStatement, getCommentRange(node));\n                    setSourceMapRange(exportStatement, moveRangePastDecorators(node));\n                    statements.push(exportStatement);\n                }\n                else {\n                    //  export default (() => { ... })();\n                    const exportStatement = factory.createExportDefault(iife);\n                    setOriginalNode(exportStatement, node);\n                    setCommentRange(exportStatement, getCommentRange(node));\n                    setSourceMapRange(exportStatement, moveRangePastDecorators(node));\n                    statements.push(exportStatement);\n                }\n          const iife = transformClassLike(node);\n                const modifierVisitorNoExport = isExport ? ((node: ModifierLike) => isExportModifier(node) ? undefined : modifierVisitor(node)) : modifierVisitor;\n                const modifiers = visitNodes(node.modifiers, modifierVisitorNoExport, isModifier);\n                const declName = factory.getLocalName(node, /*allowComments*/ false, /*allowSourceMaps*/ true);\n                const varDecl = factory.createVariableDeclaration(declName, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, iife);\n                setOriginalNode(varDecl, node);\n\n                const varDecls = factory.createVariableDeclarationList([varDecl], NodeFlags.Let);\n                const varStatement = factory.createVariableStatement(modifiers, varDecls);\n                setOriginalNode(varStatement, node);\n                setCommentRange(varStatement, getCommentRange(node));\n                statements.push(varStatement);\n                if (isExport) {\n                    //  export { C };\n                    const exportStatement = factory.createExternalModuleExport(declName);\n                    setOriginalNode(exportStatement, node);\n                    statements.push(exportStatement);\n                }\n            }\n            return singleOrMany(statements);\n        }\n        else {\n            const modifiers = visitNodes(node.modifiers, modifierVisitor, isModifier);\n            const heritageClauses = visitNodes(node.heritageClauses, visitor, isHeritageClause);\n            enterClass(/*classInfo*/ undefined);\n            const members = visitNodes(node.members, classElementVisitor, isClassElement);\n            exitClass();\n            return factory.updateClassDeclaration(node, modifiers, node.name, /*typeParameters*/ undefined, heritageClauses, members);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function visitClassExpression(node: ClassExpression) {\n        if (isDecoratedClassLike(node)) {\n            const iife = transformClassLike(node);\n            setOriginalNode(iife, node);\n            return iife;\n        }\n        else {\n            const modifiers = visitNodes(node.modifiers, modifierVisitor, isModifier);\n            const heritageClauses = visitNodes(node.heritageClauses, visitor, isHeritageClause);\n            enterClass(/*classInfo*/ undefined);\n            const members = visitNodes(node.members, classElementVisitor, isClassElement);\n            exitClass();\n            return factory.updateClassExpression(node, modifiers, node.name, /*typeParameters*/ undefined, heritageClauses, members);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function prepareConstructor(_parent: ClassLikeDeclaration, classInfo: ClassInfo) {\n        // Decorated instance members can add \"extra\" initializers to the instance. If a class contains any instance\n        // fields, we'll inject the `__runInitializers()` call for these extra initializers into the initializer of\n        // the first class member that will be initialized. However, if the class does not contain any fields that\n        // we can piggyback on, we need to synthesize a `__runInitializers()` call in the constructor instead.\n        if (some(classInfo.pendingInstanceInitializers)) {\n            // If there are instance extra initializers we need to add them to the body along with any\n            // field initializers\n            const statements: Statement[] = [];\n\n            statements.push(\n                factory.createExpressionStatement(\n                    factory.inlineExpressions(classInfo.pendingInstanceInitializers),\n                ),\n            );\n\n            classInfo.pendingInstanceInitializers = undefined;\n            return statements;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function transformConstructorBodyWorker(statementsOut: Statement[], statementsIn: NodeArray<Statement>, statementOffset: number, superPath: readonly number[], superPathDepth: number, initializerStatements: readonly Statement[]) {\n        const superStatementIndex = superPath[superPathDepth]!;\n        const superStatement = statementsIn[superStatementIndex]!;\n        addRange(statementsOut, visitNodes(statementsIn, visitor, isStatement, statementOffset, superStatementIndex - statementOffset));\n        if (isTryStatement(superStatement)) {\n            const tryBlockStatements: Statement[] = [];\n\n            transformConstructorBodyWorker(\n                tryBlockStatements,\n                superStatement.tryBlock.statements,\n                /*statementOffset*/ 0,\n                superPath,\n                superPathDepth + 1,\n                initializerStatements,\n            );\n\n            const tryBlockStatementsArray = factory.createNodeArray(tryBlockStatements);\n            setTextRange(tryBlockStatementsArray, superStatement.tryBlock.statements);\n\n            statementsOut.push(factory.updateTryStatement(\n                superStatement,\n                factory.updateBlock(superStatement.tryBlock, tryBlockStatements),\n                visitNode(superStatement.catchClause, visitor, isCatchClause),\n                visitNode(superStatement.finallyBlock, visitor, isBlock),\n            ));\n        }\n        else {\n            addRange(statementsOut, visitNodes(statementsIn, visitor, isStatement, superStatementIndex, 1));\n            addRange(statementsOut, initializerStatements);\n        }\n        addRange(statementsOut, visitNodes(statementsIn, visitor, isStatement, superStatementIndex + 1));\n    }\n\n    function visitConstructorDeclaration(node: ConstructorDeclaration) {\n        enterClassElement(node);\n        const modifiers = visitNodes(node.modifiers, modifierVisitor, isModifier);\n        const parameters = visitNodes(node.parameters, visitor, isParameter);\n        let body: Block | undefined;\n        if (node.body && classInfo) {\n            // If there are instance extra initializers we need to add them to the body along with any\n            // field initializers\n            const initializerStatements = prepareConstructor(classInfo.class, classInfo);\n            if (initializerStatements) {\n                const statements: Statement[] = [];\n                const nonPrologueStart = factory.copyPrologue(node.body.statements, statements, /*ensureUseStrict*/ false, visitor);\n                const superStatementIndices = findSuperStatementIndexPath(node.body.statements, nonPrologueStart);\n                if (superStatementIndices.length > 0) {\n                    transformConstructorBodyWorker(statements, node.body.statements, nonPrologueStart, superStatementIndices, 0, initializerStatements);\n                }\n                else {\n                    addRange(statements, initializerStatements);\n                    addRange(statements, visitNodes(node.body.statements, visitor, isStatement));\n                }\n                body = factory.createBlock(statements, /*multiLine*/ true);\n                setOriginalNode(body, node.body);\n                setTextRange(body, node.body);\n            }\n        }\n\n        body ??= visitNode(node.body, visitor, isBlock);\n        exitClassElement();\n        return factory.updateConstructorDeclaration(node, modifiers, parameters, body);\n    }\n\n    function finishClassElement(updated: ClassElement, original: ClassElement) {\n        if (updated !== original) {\n            // While we emit the source map for the node after skipping decorators and modifiers,\n            // we need to emit the comments for the original range.\n            setCommentRange(updated, original);\n            setSourceMapRange(updated, moveRangePastDecorators(original));\n        }\n        return updated;\n    }\n\n    function partialTransformClassElement<\n        TNode extends MethodDeclaration | PropertyDeclaration | GetAccessorDeclaration | SetAccessorDeclaration,\n    >(\n        member: TNode,\n        classInfo: ClassInfo | undefined,\n        createDescriptor?: (node: TNode & { readonly name: PrivateIdentifier; }, modifiers: ModifiersArray | undefined) => Expression,\n    ) {\n        let referencedName: Expression | undefined;\n        let name: PropertyName | undefined;\n        let initializersName: Identifier | undefined;\n        let extraInitializersName: Identifier | undefined;\n        let isModifier);\n            enterName();\n            name = visitPropertyName(member.name);\n            exitName();\n            return { modifiers, referencedName, name, initializersName, descriptorName, thisArg };\n        }\n\n        // Member decorators require privileged access to private names. However, computed property\n        // evaluation occurs interspersed with decorator evaluation. This means that if we encounter\n        // a computed property name we must inline decorator evaluation.\n        const memberDecorators = transformAllDecoratorsOfDeclaration(getAllDecoratorsOfClassElement(member, classInfo.class, /*useLegacyDecorators*/ false));\n        const modifiers = visitNodes(member.modifiers, modifierVisitor, isModifier);\n\n        if (memberDecorators) {\n            const memberDecoratorsName = createHelperVariable(member, \"decorators\");\n            const memberDecoratorsArray = factory.createArrayLiteralExpression(memberDecorators);\n            const memberDecoratorsAssignment = factory.createAssignment(memberDecoratorsName, memberDecoratorsArray);\n            const memberInfo: MemberInfo = { memberDecoratorsName };\n            classInfo.memberInfos ??= new Map();\n            classInfo.memberInfos.set(member, memberInfo);\n            pendingExpressions ??= [];\n            pendingExpressions.push(memberDecoratorsAssignment);\n\n            // 5.    if (isStatic(member)) {\n                    thisArg = classInfo.classThis;\n                }\n\n                let descriptor: Expression | undefined;\n                if isAutoAccessorPropertyDeclaration(member) ?\n                        factory.createThis() :\n                        factory.createNull(),\n                    descriptor ?? factory.createNull(),\n                    memberDecoratorsName,\n                    context,\n                    initializersName,\n                    extraInitializersName,\n                );\n                const esDecorateStatement = factory.createExpressionStatement(esDecorateExpression);\n                setSourceMapRange(esDecorateStatement, moveRangePastDecorators(member));\n exitName();\n        }\n\n        if (!some(modifiers) && (isMethodDeclaration(member) || isPropertyDeclaration(member))) {\n            // Don't emit leading comments on the name for methods and modifiers, referencedName, name, initializersName, extraInitializersName, descriptorName, thisArg };\n    }\n\n    function visitMethodDeclaration(node: MethodDeclaration) {\n        }\n    }\n\n    function visitGetAccessorDeclaration(node: GetAccessorDeclaration) {\n        enterClassElement(node);\n        const { modifiers, name, descriptorName } = ClassStaticBlockDeclaration): VisitResult<ClassStaticBlockDeclaration> {\n        enterClassElement(node);\n\n        let result: VisitResult<ClassStaticBlockDeclaration>;\n        if (isClassNamedEvaluationHelperBlock(node)) {\n            result = visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n        }\n        else if (isClassThisAssignmentBlock(node)) {\n            const We need to consider whether we will support them in the\n        //                 future, and how. For now, these should be elided by the `ts` transform.\n        Debug.assert(!isAmbientPropertyDeclaration(node), \"Not yet implemented.\");\n\n        // 10.2.1.3 RS: EvaluateBody\n        //   Initializer : `=` AssignmentExpression\n        //     ...\n        //     3.    let initializer = visitNode(node.initializer, visitor, isExpression);\n        if (initializersName) {\n            initializer = emitHelpers().createRunInitializersHelper(\n                thisArg factory.createImmediatelyInvokedArrowFunction([\n                ...declarations,\n                factory.createReturnStatement(initializer),\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        if (classInfo) {\n            if (isStatic(node)) {\n                initializer = injectPendingInitializers(classInfo, /*isStatic*/ true, initializer);\n                if (extraInitializersName) {\n    classInfo.classThis ?? factory.createThis(),\n                            extraInitializersName,\n                        ),\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        factory.createThis(),\n                            extraInitializersName,\n                        ),\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n = getCommentRange(node);\n            const sourceMapRange = getSourceMapRange(node);\n\n            // Since we're creating two declarations where there was previously one, cache\n            // the && !isSimpleInlineableExpression(name.expression)) {\n                const cacheAssignment = findComputedPropertyNameCacheAssignment(name);\n                if (cacheAssignment) {\n                    getterName = factory.updateComputedPropertyName(name, visitNode(name.expression, visitor, isExpression));\n                    setterName = factory.updateComputedPropertyName(name, cacheAssignment.left);\n                }\n                else {\n                    const temp = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n                    setSourceMapRange(temp, name.expression);\n                    const expression = visitNode(name.expression, visitor, isExpression);\n                    const assignment = factory.createAssignment(temp, expression);\n                    setSourceMapRange(assignment, name.expression);\n                    getterName = factory.updateComputedPropertyName(name, assignment);\n                    setterName = factory.updateComputedPropertyName(name, temp);\n                }\n            }\n\n            const modifiersWithoutAccessor = visitNodes(modifiers, node => node.kind !== SyntaxKind.AccessorKeyword ? node : undefined, isModifier);\n\n            const backingField = createAccessorPropertyBackingField(factory, node, modifiersWithoutAccessor, initializer);\n            setOriginalNode(backingField, node);\n            setEmitFlags(backingField, EmitFlags.NoComments);\n            setSourceMapRange(backingField, sourceMapRange);\n setOriginalNode(getter, node);\n            setCommentRange(getter, commentRange);\n            setSourceMapRange(getter, sourceMapRange);\n\n            const setter = createSetAccessorDescriptorForwarder(modifiersWithoutAccessor, setterName, descriptorName);\n            setOriginalNode(setter, node);\n            setEmitFlags(setter, EmitFlags.NoComments);\n            setSourceMapRange(setter, sourceMapRange);\n\n            return [backingField, getter, setter];\n        }\n\n        return finishClassElement(factory.updatePropertyDeclaration(node, modifiers, name, /*questionOrExclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, initializer), node);\n    }\n\n    function visitThisExpression(node: ThisExpression) {\n        return classThis ?? node;\n    }\n\n    function visitCallExpression(node: CallExpression) {\n        if (isSuperProperty(node.expression) && classThis) {\n            const expression = visitNode(node.expression, visitor,        const template = visitNode(node.template, visitor, isTemplateLiteral);\n            return factory.updateTaggedTemplateExpression(node, boundTag, /*typeArguments*/ undefined, template);\n IteratorBindingInitialization\n        //   SingleNameBinding : BindingIdentifier Initializer?\n        //     ...\n        //     5. NamedEvaluation of |Initializer| with argument _bindingId_.\n        //     ...\n        //\n        // 14.3.3.3 RS: KeyedBindingInitialization\n        //   SingleNameBinding : BindingIdentifier Initializer?\n        //     ...\n        //     4. If |Initializer| is present and _v_ is *undefined*, then\n        //        a. If IsAnonymousFunctionDefinition(|Initializer|) is *true*, then\n        //           i. Set _v_ to ? However, The IIFE\n        // produced for `(class { @dec x; })` will not result in an assigned name since it\n        // transforms to `return class { };`, and thus the empty string *can* be ignored.\n\n        const innerExpression = skipOuterExpressions(node);\n        return isClassExpression(innerExpression) && !innerExpression.name && !classOrConstructorParameterIsDecorated(/*useLegacyDecorators*/ false, innerExpression);\n    }\n\n    function visitForStatement(node: ForStatement) {\n        return factory.updateForStatement(\n            node,\n            visitNode(node.initializer, discardedValueVisitor, isForInitializer),\n            visitNode(node.condition, visitor, isExpression),\n            visitNode(node.incrementor, discardedValueVisitor, isExpression),\n            visitIterationBody(node.statement, visitor, context),\n        );\n    }\n\n    function visitExpressionStatement(node: ExpressionStatement) {\n        return visitEachChild(node, discardedValueVisitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitBinaryExpression(node: BinaryExpression, discarded: boolean) {\n        if (isDestructuringAssignment(node)) {\n            const left = visitAssignmentPattern(node.left);\n            const right = visitNode(node.right, visitor, isExpression);\n            return factory.updateBinaryExpression(node, left, node.operatorToken, right);\n        }\n\n        if (isAssignmentExpression(node)) {\n            // 13.15.2 RS: Evaluation\n            //   AssignmentExpression : LeftHandSideExpression `=` AssignmentExpression\n            //     1. If |LeftHandSideExpression| is neither an |ObjectLiteral| nor an |ArrayLiteral|, then\n            //        a. Let _lref_ be ? Evaluation of |LeftHandSideExpression|.\n            //        b. If IsAnonymousFunctionDefinition(|AssignmentExpression|) and IsIdentifierRef of |LeftHandSideExpression| are both *true*, then\n            //           i. Let _rval_ be ? NamedEvaluation of |AssignmentExpression| with argument _lref_.[[ReferencedName]].\n            //     ...\n            //\n            //   AssignmentExpression : LeftHandSideExpression `&&=` AssignmentExpression\n            //     ...\n            //     5. If IsAnonymousFunctionDefinition(|AssignmentExpression|) is *true* and IsIdentifierRef of |LeftHandSideExpression| is *true*, then\n            //        a. Let _rval_ be ? NamedEvaluation of |AssignmentExpression| with argument _lref_.[[ReferencedName]].\n            //     ...\n            //\n            //   AssignmentExpression : LeftHandSideExpression `||=` AssignmentExpression\n            //     ...\n            //     5. If IsAnonymousFunctionDefinition(|AssignmentExpression|) is *true* and IsIdentifierRef of |LeftHandSideExpression| is *true*, then\n            //        a. Let _rval_ be ? NamedEvaluation of |AssignmentExpression| with argument _lref_.[[ReferencedName]].\n            //     ...\n            //\n            //   AssignmentExpression : LeftHandSideExpression `??=` AssignmentExpression\n            //     ...\n            //     4. If IsAnonymousFunctionDefinition(|AssignmentExpression|) is *true* and IsIdentifierRef of |LeftHandSideExpression| is *true*, then\n            //        a. Let _rval_ be ? NamedEvaluation of |AssignmentExpression| with argument _lref_.[[ReferencedName]].\n            //     ...\n\n            if (isNamedEvaluation(node, isAnonymousClassNeedingAssignedName)) {\n                node = transformNamedEvaluation(context, node, canIgnoreEmptyStringLiteralInAssignedName(node.right));\n                return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n            }\n\n            if (isSuperProperty(node.left) && classThis && classSuper) {\n                let setterName = isElementAccessExpression(node.left) ? visitNode(node.left.argumentExpression, visitor, isExpression) :\n                    isIdentifier(node.left.name) ? factory.createStringLiteralFromNode(node.left.name) :\n                    undefined;\n                if (setterName) {\n                    // super.x = ...\n                    // super.x += ...\n                    // super[x] = ...\n                    // super[x] += ...\n                    let expression = visitNode(node.right, visitor, isExpression);\n                    if (isCompoundAssignment(node.operatorToken.kind)) {\n                        let getterName = setterName;\n                        if (!isSimpleInlineableExpression(setterName)) {\n                            getterName = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n                            setterName = factory.createAssignment(getterName, setterName);\n                        }\n\n                        const superPropertyGet = factory.createReflectGetCall(\n                            classSuper,\n                            getterName,\n                            classThis,\n                        );\n                        setOriginalNode(superPropertyGet, node.left);\n                        setTextRange(superPropertyGet, node.left);\n\n                        expression = factory.createBinaryExpression(\n                            superPropertyGet,\n                            getNonAssignmentOperatorForCompoundAssignment(node.operatorToken.kind),\n                            expression,\n                        );\n                        setTextRange(expression, node);\n                    }\n\n                    const temp = discarded ? undefined : factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n                    if (temp) {\n                        expression = factory.createAssignment(temp, expression);\n                        setTextRange(temp, node);\n                    }\n\n                    expression = factory.createReflectSetCall(\n                        classSuper,\n                        setterName,\n                        expression,\n                        classThis,\n                    );\n                    setOriginalNode(expression, node);\n                    setTextRange(expression, node);\n\n                    if (temp) {\n                        expression = factory.createComma(expression, temp);\n                        setTextRange(expression, node);\n                    }\n\n                    return expression;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (node.operatorToken.kind === SyntaxKind.CommaToken) {\n            const left = visitNode(node.left, discardedValueVisitor, isExpression);\n            const right = visitNode(node.right, discarded ? discardedValueVisitor : visitor, isExpression);\n            return factory.updateBinaryExpression(node, left, node.operatorToken, right);\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitPreOrPostfixUnaryExpression(node: PrefixUnaryExpression | PostfixUnaryExpression, discarded: boolean) {\n        if (\n            node.operator === SyntaxKind.PlusPlusToken ||\n            node.operator === SyntaxKind.MinusMinusToken\n        ) {\n            const operand = skipParentheses(node.operand);\n            if (isSuperProperty(operand) && classThis && classSuper) {\n                let setterName = isElementAccessExpression(operand) ? visitNode(operand.argumentExpression, visitor, isExpression) :\n                    isIdentifier(operand.name) ? factory.createStringLiteralFromNode(operand.name) :\n                    undefined;\n                if (setterName) {\n                    let getterName = setterName;\n                    if (!isSimpleInlineableExpression(setterName)) {\n                        getterName = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n                        setterName = factory.createAssignment(getterName, setterName);\n                    }\n\n                    let expression: Expression = factory.createReflectGetCall(classSuper, getterName, classThis);\n                    setOriginalNode(expression, node);\n                    setTextRange(expression, node);\n\n                    // If the result of this expression is discarded (i.e., it's in a position where the result\n                    // will be otherwise unused, such as in an expression statement or the left side of a comma), we\n                    // don't need to create an extra temp variable to hold the result:\n                    //\n                    //  source (discarded):\n                    //    super.x++;\n                    //  generated:\n                    //    _a = Reflect.get(_super, \"x\"), _a++, Reflect.set(_super, \"x\", _a);\n                    //\n                    // Above, the temp variable `_a` is used to perform the correct coercion (i.e., number or\n                    // bigint). Since the result of the postfix unary is discarded, we don't need to capture the\n                    // result of the expression.\n                    //\n                    //  source (not discarded):\n                    //    y = super.x++;\n                    //  generated:\n                    //    y = (_a = Reflect.get(_super, \"x\"), _b = _a++, Reflect.set(_super, \"x\", _a), _b);\n                    //\n                    // When the result isn't discarded, we introduce a new temp variable (`_b`) to capture the\n                    // result of the operation so that we can provide it to `y` when the assignment is complete.\n\n                    const temp = discarded ? undefined : factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n                    expression = expandPreOrPostfixIncrementOrDecrementExpression(factory, node, expression, hoistVariableDeclaration, temp);\n                    expression = factory.createReflectSetCall(classSuper, setterName, expression, classThis);\n                    setOriginalNode(expression, node);\n                    setTextRange(expression, node);\n\n                    if (temp) {\n                        expression = factory.createComma(expression, temp);\n                        setTextRange(expression, node);\n                    }\n\n                    return expression;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitCommaListExpression(node: CommaListExpression, discarded: boolean) {\n        const elements = HierarchyFacts.ClassOrFunctionIncludes,\n                );\n            case SyntaxKind.FunctionExpression:\n                return doWithHierarchyFacts(\n                    visitFunctionExpression,\n                    node as FunctionExpression,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ClassOrFunctionExcludes,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ClassOrFunctionIncludes,\n                );\n            case SyntaxKind.ArrowFunction:\n                return doWithHierarchyFacts(\n                    visitArrowFunction,\n                    node as ArrowFunction,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ArrowFunctionExcludes,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ArrowFunctionIncludes,\n                );\n            case SyntaxKind.Parameter:\n                return visitParameter(node as ParameterDeclaration);\n            case SyntaxKind.ExpressionStatement:\n                return visitExpressionStatement(node as ExpressionStatement);\n            case SyntaxKind.ParenthesizedExpression:\n                return visitParenthesizedExpression(node as ParenthesizedExpression, expressionResultIsUnused);\n            case SyntaxKind.TaggedTemplateExpression:\n                return visitTaggedTemplateExpression(node as TaggedTemplateExpression);\n            case SyntaxKind.PropertyAccessExpression:\n                if (capturedSuperProperties && isPropertyAccessExpression(node) && node.expression.kind === SyntaxKind.SuperKeyword) {\n                    capturedSuperProperties.add(node.name.escapedText);\n                }\n                return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n            case SyntaxKind.ElementAccessExpression:\n                if (capturedSuperProperties && (node as ElementAccessExpression).expression.kind === SyntaxKind.SuperKeyword) {\n                    hasSuperElementAccess = true;\n                }\n                return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n            case SyntaxKind.ClassDeclaration:\n            case SyntaxKind.ClassExpression:\n                return doWithHierarchyFacts(\n                    visitDefault,\n                    node,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ClassOrFunctionExcludes,\n                    HierarchyFacts.ClassOrFunctionIncludes,\n                );\n            default:\n                return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function visitAwaitExpression(node: AwaitExpression): Expression {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async && enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator) {\n            return setOriginalNode(\n                setTextRange(\n                    factory.createYieldExpression(/*asteriskToken*/ undefined, emitHelpers().createAwaitHelper(visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression))),\n                    /*location*/ node,\n                ),\n                node,\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitYieldExpression(node: YieldExpression) {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async && enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator) {\n            if (node.asteriskToken) {\n                const expression = visitNode(Debug.checkDefined(node.expression), visitor, isExpression);\n\n                return setOriginalNode(\n                    setTextRange(\n                        factory.createYieldExpression(\n                            /*asteriskToken*/ undefined,\n                            emitHelpers().createAwaitHelper(\n                                factory.updateYieldExpression(\n                                    node,\n                                    node.asteriskToken,\n                                    setTextRange(\n                                        emitHelpers().createAsyncDelegatorHelper(\n                                            setTextRange(\n                                                emitHelpers().createAsyncValuesHelper(expression),\n                                                expression,\n                                            ),\n                                        ),\n                                        expression,\n                                    ),\n                                ),\n                            ),\n                        ),\n                        node,\n                    ),\n                    node,\n                );\n            }\n\n            return setOriginalNode(\n                setTextRange(\n                    factory.createYieldExpression(\n                        /*asteriskToken*/ undefined,\n                        createDownlevelAwait(\n                            node.expression\n                                ? visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression)\n                                : factory.createVoidZero(),\n                        ),\n                    ),\n                    node,\n                ),\n                node,\n            );\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitReturnStatement(node: ReturnStatement) {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async && enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator) {\n            return factory.updateReturnStatement(\n                node,\n                createDownlevelAwait(\n                    node.expression ? visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression) : factory.createVoidZero(),\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitLabeledStatement(node: LabeledStatement) {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async) {\n            const statement = unwrapInnermostStatementOfLabel(node);\n            if (statement.kind === SyntaxKind.ForOfStatement && (statement as ForOfStatement).awaitModifier) {\n                return visitForOfStatement(statement as ForOfStatement, node);\n            }\n            return factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(visitNode(statement, visitor, isStatement, factory.liftToBlock), node);\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function chunkObjectLiteralElements(elements: readonly ObjectLiteralElementLike[]): Expression[] {\n        let chunkObject: ObjectLiteralElementLike[] | undefined;\n        const objects: Expression[] = [];\n        for (const e of elements) {\n            if (e.kind === SyntaxKind.SpreadAssignment) {\n                if (chunkObject) {\n                    objects.push(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression(chunkObject));\n                    chunkObject = undefined;\n                }\n                const target = e.expression;\n                objects.push(visitNode(target, visitor, isExpression));\n            }\n            else {\n                chunkObject = append(\n                    chunkObject,\n                    e.kind === SyntaxKind.PropertyAssignment\n                        ? factory.createPropertyAssignment(e.name, visitNode(e.initializer, visitor, isExpression))\n                        : visitNode(e, visitor, isObjectLiteralElementLike),\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        if (chunkObject) {\n            objects.push(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression(chunkObject));\n        }\n\n        return objects;\n    }\n\n    function visitObjectLiteralExpression(node: ObjectLiteralExpression): Expression {\n        if (node.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread) {\n            // spread elements emit like so:\n            // non-spread elements are chunked together into object literals, and then all are passed to __assign:\n            //     { a, ...o, b } => __assign(__assign({a}, o), {b});\n            // If the first element is a spread element, then the first argument to __assign is {}:\n            //     { ...o, a, b, ...o2 } => __assign(__assign(__assign({}, o), {a, b}), o2)\n            //\n            // We cannot call __assign with more than two elements, since any element could cause side effects. For\n            // example:\n            //      var k = { a: 1, b: 2 };\n            //      var o = { a: 3, ...k, b: k.a++ };\n            //      // expected: { a: 1, b: 1 }\n            // If we translate the above to `__assign({ a: 3 }, k, { b: k.a++ })`, the `k.a++` will evaluate before\n            // `k` is spread and we end up with `{ a: 2, b: 1 }`.\n            //\n            // This also occurs for spread elements, not just property assignments:\n            //      var k = { a: 1, get b() { l = { z: 9 }; return 2; } };\n            //      var l = { c: 3 };\n            //      var o = { ...k, ...l };\n            //      // expected: { a: 1, b: 2, z: 9 }\n            // If we translate the above to `__assign({}, k, l)`, the `l` will evaluate before `k` is spread and we\n            // end up with `{ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 }`\n            const objects = chunkObjectLiteralElements(node.properties);\n            if (objects.length && objects[0]!.kind !== SyntaxKind.ObjectLiteralExpression) {\n                objects.unshift(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression());\n            }\n            let expression: Expression = objects[0]!;\n            if (objects.length > 1) {\n                for (let i = 1; i < objects.length; i++) {\n                    expression = emitHelpers().createAssignHelper([expression, objects[i]!]);\n                }\n                return expression;\n            }\n            else {\n                return emitHelpers().createAssignHelper(objects);\n            }\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitExpressionStatement(node: ExpressionStatement): ExpressionStatement {\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitParenthesizedExpression(node: ParenthesizedExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): ParenthesizedExpression {\n        return visitEachChild(node, expressionResultIsUnused ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitSourceFile(node: SourceFile): SourceFile {\n        const ancestorFacts = enterSubtree(\n            HierarchyFacts.SourceFileExcludes,\n            isEffectiveStrictModeSourceFile(node, compilerOptions) ?\n                HierarchyFacts.StrictModeSourceFileIncludes :\n                HierarchyFacts.SourceFileIncludes,\n        );\n        exportedVariableStatement = false;\n        const visited = visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n        const statement = concatenate(\n            visited.statements,\n            taggedTemplateStringDeclarations && [\n                factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, factory.createVariableDeclarationList(taggedTemplateStringDeclarations)),\n            ],\n        );\n        const result = factory.updateSourceFile(visited, setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(statement), node.statements));\n        exitSubtree(ancestorFacts);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function visitTaggedTemplateExpression(node: TaggedTemplateExpression) {\n        return processTaggedTemplateExpression(\n            context,\n            node,\n            visitor,\n            currentSourceFile,\n            recordTaggedTemplateString,\n            ProcessLevel.LiftRestriction,\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Visits a BinaryExpression that contains a destructuring assignment.\n     *\n     * @param node A BinaryExpression node.\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitBinaryExpression(node: BinaryExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): Expression {\n        if (isDestructuringAssignment(node) && containsObjectRestOrSpread(node.left)) {\n            return flattenDestructuringAssignment(\n                node,\n                visitor,\n                context,\n                FlattenLevel.ObjectRest,\n                !expressionResultIsUnused,\n            );\n        }\n        if (node.operatorToken.kind === SyntaxKind.CommaToken) {\n            return factory.updateBinaryExpression(\n                node,\n                visitNode(node.left, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, isExpression),\n                node.operatorToken,\n                visitNode(node.right, expressionResultIsUnused ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, isExpression),\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitCommaListExpression(node: CommaListExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): Expression {\n        if (expressionResultIsUnused) {\n            return visitEachChild(node, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n        }\n        let result: Expression[] | undefined;\n        for (let i = 0; i < node.elements.length; i++) {\n            const element = node.elements[i]!;\n            const visited = visitNode(element, i < node.elements.length - 1 ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, isExpression);\n            if (result || visited !== element) {\n                result ||= node.elements.slice(0, i);\n                result.push(visited);\n            }\n        }\n        const elements = result ? setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(result), node.elements) : node.elements;\n        return factory.updateCommaListExpression(node, elements);\n    }\n\n    function visitCatchClause(node: CatchClause) {\n        if (\n            node.variableDeclaration &&\n            isBindingPattern(node.variableDeclaration.name) &&\n            node.variableDeclaration.name.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread\n        ) {\n            const name = factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(node.variableDeclaration.name);\n            const updatedDecl = factory.updateVariableDeclaration(node.variableDeclaration, node.variableDeclaration.name, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, name);\n            const visitedBindings = flattenDestructuringBinding(updatedDecl, visitor, context, FlattenLevel.ObjectRest);\n            let block = visitNode(node.block, visitor, isBlock);\n            if (some(visitedBindings)) {\n                block = factory.updateBlock(block, [\n                    factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, visitedBindings),\n                    ...block.statements,\n                ]);\n            }\n            return factory.updateCatchClause(\n                node,\n                factory.updateVariableDeclaration(node.variableDeclaration, name, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, /*initializer*/ undefined),\n                block,\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitVariableStatement(node: VariableStatement): VisitResult<VariableStatement> {\n        if (hasSyntacticModifier(node, ModifierFlags.Export)) {\n            const savedExportedVariableStatement = exportedVariableStatement;\n            exportedVariableStatement = true;\n            const visited = visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n            exportedVariableStatement = savedExportedVariableStatement;\n            return visited;\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Visits a VariableDeclaration node with a binding pattern.\n     *\n     * @param node A VariableDeclaration node.\n     */\n    function visitVariableDeclaration(node: VariableDeclaration): VisitResult<VariableDeclaration> {\n        if (exportedVariableStatement) {\n            const savedExportedVariableStatement = exportedVariableStatement;\n            exportedVariableStatement = false;\n            const visited = visitVariableDeclarationWorker(node, /*exportedVariableStatement*/ true);\n            exportedVariableStatement = savedExportedVariableStatement;\n            return visited;\n        }\n        return visitVariableDeclarationWorker(node, /*exportedVariableStatement*/ false);\n    }\n\n    function visitVariableDeclarationWorker(node: VariableDeclaration, exportedVariableStatement: boolean): VisitResult<VariableDeclaration> {\n        // If we are here it is because the name contains a binding pattern with a rest somewhere in it.\n        if (isBindingPattern(node.name) && node.name.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread) {\n            return flattenDestructuringBinding(\n                node,\n                visitor,\n                context,\n                FlattenLevel.ObjectRest,\n                /*rval*/ undefined,\n                exportedVariableStatement,\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitForStatement(node: ForStatement): VisitResult<Statement> {\n        return factory.updateForStatement(\n            node,\n            visitNode(node.initializer, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, isForInitializer),\n            visitNode(node.condition, visitor, isExpression),\n            visitNode(node.incrementor, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, isExpression),\n            visitIterationBody(node.statement, visitor, context),\n        );\n    }\n\n    function visitVoidExpression(node: VoidExpression) {\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Visits a ForOfStatement and converts it into a ES2015-compatible ForOfStatement.\n     *\n     * @param node A ForOfStatement.\n     */\n    function visitForOfStatement(node: ForOfStatement, outermostLabeledStatement: LabeledStatement | undefined): VisitResult<Statement> {\n        const ancestorFacts = enterSubtree(HierarchyFacts.IterationStatementExcludes, HierarchyFacts.IterationStatementIncludes);\n        if (\n            node.initializer.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread ||\n            isAssignmentPattern(node.initializer) && containsObjectRestOrSpread(node.initializer)\n        ) {\n            node = transformForOfStatementWithObjectRest(node);\n        }\n        const result = node.awaitModifier ?\n            transformForAwaitOfStatement(node, outermostLabeledStatement, ancestorFacts) :\n            factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(visitEachChild(node, visitor, context), outermostLabeledStatement);\n        exitSubtree(ancestorFacts);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function transformForOfStatementWithObjectRest(node: ForOfStatement) {\n        const initializerWithoutParens = skipParentheses(node.initializer) as ForInitializer;\n        if (isVariableDeclarationList(initializerWithoutParens) || isAssignmentPattern(initializerWithoutParens)) {\n            let bodyLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n            let statementsLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n            const temp = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n            const statements: Statement[] = [createForOfBindingStatement(factory, initializerWithoutParens, temp)];\n            if (isBlock(node.statement)) {\n                addRange(statements, node.statement.statements);\n                bodyLocation = node.statement;\n                statementsLocation = node.statement.statements;\n            }\n            else if (node.statement) {\n                append(statements, node.statement);\n                bodyLocation = node.statement;\n                statementsLocation = node.statement;\n            }\n            return factory.updateForOfStatement(\n                node,\n                node.awaitModifier,\n                setTextRange(\n                    factory.createVariableDeclarationList(\n                        [\n                            setTextRange(factory.createVariableDeclaration(temp), node.initializer),\n                        ],\n                        NodeFlags.Let,\n                    ),\n                    node.initializer,\n                ),\n                node.expression,\n                setTextRange(\n                    factory.createBlock(\n                        setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(statements), statementsLocation),\n                        /*multiLine*/ true,\n                    ),\n                    bodyLocation,\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n        return node;\n    }\n\n    function convertForOfStatementHead(node: ForOfStatement, boundValue: Expression, nonUserCode: Identifier) {\n        const value = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n        const iteratorValueExpression = factory.createAssignment(value, boundValue);\n        const iteratorValueStatement = factory.createExpressionStatement(iteratorValueExpression);\n        setSourceMapRange(iteratorValueStatement, node.expression);\n\n        const exitNonUserCodeExpression = factory.createAssignment(nonUserCode, factory.createFalse());\n        const exitNonUserCodeStatement = factory.createExpressionStatement(exitNonUserCodeExpression);\n        setSourceMapRange(exitNonUserCodeStatement, node.expression);\n\n        const statements: Statement[] = [iteratorValueStatement, exitNonUserCodeStatement];\n        const binding = createForOfBindingStatement(factory, node.initializer, value);\n        statements.push(visitNode(binding, visitor, isStatement));\n\n        let bodyLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n        let statementsLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n        const statement = visitIterationBody(node.statement, visitor, context);\n        if (isBlock(statement)) {\n            addRange(statements, statement.statements);\n            bodyLocation = statement;\n            statementsLocation = statement.statements;\n        }\n        else {\n            statements.push(statement);\n        }\n\n        return setTextRange(\n            factory.createBlock(\n                setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(statements), statementsLocation),\n                /*multiLine*/ true,\n            ),\n            bodyLocation,\n        );\n    }\n\n    function createDownlevelAwait(expression: Expression) {\n        return enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator\n            ? factory.createYieldExpression(/*asteriskToken*/ undefined, emitHelpers().createAwaitHelper(expression))\n            : factory.createAwaitExpression(expression);\n    }\n\n    function transformForAwaitOfStatement(node: ForOfStatement, outermostLabeledStatement: LabeledStatement | undefined, ancestorFacts: HierarchyFacts) {\n        const expression = visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression);\n        const iterator = isIdentifier(expression) ? factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(expression) : factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const result = isIdentifier(expression) ? factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(iterator) : factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const nonUserCode = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const done = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n        const errorRecord = factory.createUniqueName(\"e\");\n        const catchVariable = factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(errorRecord);\n        const returnMethod = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const callValues = setTextRange(emitHelpers().createAsyncValuesHelper(expression), node.expression);\n        const callNext = factory.createCallExpression(factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(iterator, \"next\"), /*typeArguments*/ undefined, []);\n        const getDone = factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(result, \"done\");\n        const getValue = factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(result, \"value\");\n        const callReturn = factory.createFunctionCallCall(returnMethod, iterator, []);\n\n        hoistVariableDeclaration(errorRecord);\n        hoistVariableDeclaration(returnMethod);\n\n        // if we are enclosed in an outer loop ensure we reset 'errorRecord' per each iteration\n        const initializer = ancestorFacts & HierarchyFacts.IterationContainer ?\n            factory.inlineExpressions([factory.createAssignment(errorRecord, factory.createVoidZero()), callValues]) :\n            callValues;\n\n        const forStatement = setEmitFlags(\n            setTextRange(\n                factory.createForStatement(\n                    /*initializer*/ setEmitFlags(\n                        setTextRange(\n                            factory.createVariableDeclarationList([\n                                factory.createVariableDeclaration(nonUserCode, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, factory.createTrue()),\n                                setTextRange(factory.createVariableDeclaration(iterator, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, initializer), node.expression),\n                                factory.createVariableDeclaration(result),\n                            ]),\n                            node.expression,\n                        ),\n                        EmitFlags.NoHoisting,\n                    ),\n                    /*condition*/ factory.inlineExpressions([\n                        factory.createAssignment(result, createDownlevelAwait(callNext)),\n                        factory.createAssignment(done, getDone),\n                        factory.createLogicalNot(done),\n                    ]),\n                    /*incrementor*/ factory.createAssignment(nonUserCode, factory.createTrue()),\n                    /*statement*/ convertForOfStatementHead(node, getValue, nonUserCode),\n                ),\n                /*location*/ node,\n            ),\n            EmitFlags.NoTokenTrailingSourceMaps,\n        );\n        setOriginalNode(forStatement, node);\n\n        return factory.createTryStatement(\n            factory.createBlock([\n                factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(\n                    forStatement,\n                    outermostLabeledStatement,\n                ),\n            ]),\n            factory.createCatchClause(\n                factory.createVariableDeclaration(catchVariable),\n                setEmitFlags(\n                    factory.createBlock([\n                        factory.createExpressionStatement(\n                            factory.createAssignment(\n                                errorRecord,\n                                factory.createObjectLiteralExpression([\n                                    factory.createPropertyAssignment(\"error\", catchVariable),\n                                ]),\n                            ),\n                        ),\n                    ]),\n                    EmitFlags.SingleLine,\n                ),\n            ),\n            factory.createBlock([\n                factory.createTryStatement(\n                    /*tryBlock*/ factory.createBlock([\n                        setEmitFlags(\n                            factory.createIfStatement(\n                                factory.createLogicalAnd(\n                                    factory.createLogicalAnd(\n                                        factory.createLogicalNot(nonUserCode),\n                                        factory.createLogicalNot(done),\n                                    ),\n                                    factory.createAssignment(\n                                        returnMethod,\n                                        factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(iterator, \"return\"),\n                                    ),\n                                ),\n                                factory.createExpressionStatement(createDownlevelAwait(callReturn)),\n                            ),\n                            EmitFlags.SingleLine,\n                        ),\n                    ]),\n                    /*catchClause*/ undefined,\n                    /*finallyBlock*/ setEmitFlags(\n                        factory.createBlock([\n                            setEmitFlags(\n                                factory.createIfStatement(\n                                    errorRecord,\n                                    factory.createThrowStatement(\n                                        factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(errorRecord, \"error\"),\n                                    ),\n                                ),\n                                EmitFlags.SingleLine,\n                            ),\n                        ]),\n                        EmitFlags.SingleLine,\n                    ),\n                ),\n            ]),\n        );\n    }\n\n    function parameterVisitor(node: Node) {\n        Debug.assertNode(node, isParameter);\n        return visitParameter(node);\n    }\n\n    function visitParameter(node: factory.createVoidZero(),\n                        ),\n                    ),\n                    node,\n                ),\n                node,\n            );\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitReturnStatement(node: ReturnStatement) {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async && enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator) {\n            return factory.updateReturnStatement(\n                node,\n                createDownlevelAwait(\n                    node.expression ? visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression) : factory.createVoidZero(),\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitLabeledStatement(node: LabeledStatement) {\n        if (enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Async) {\n            const statement = unwrapInnermostStatementOfLabel(node);\n            if (statement.kind === SyntaxKind.ForOfStatement && (statement as ForOfStatement).awaitModifier) {\n                return visitForOfStatement(statement as ForOfStatement, node);\n            }\n            return factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(visitNode(statement, visitor, isStatement, factory.liftToBlock), node);\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function chunkObjectLiteralElements(elements: readonly ObjectLiteralElementLike[]): Expression[] {\n        let chunkObject: ObjectLiteralElementLike[] | undefined;\n        const objects: Expression[] = [];\n        for (const e of elements) {\n            if (e.kind === SyntaxKind.SpreadAssignment) {\n                if (chunkObject) {\n                    objects.push(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression(chunkObject));\n                    chunkObject = undefined;\n                }\n                const target = e.expression;\n                objects.push(visitNode(target, visitor, isExpression));\n            }\n            else {\n                chunkObject = append(\n                    chunkObject,\n                    e.kind === SyntaxKind.PropertyAssignment\n                        ? factory.createPropertyAssignment(e.name, visitNode(e.initializer, visitor, isExpression))\n                        : visitNode(e, visitor, isObjectLiteralElementLike),\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        if (chunkObject) {\n            objects.push(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression(chunkObject));\n        }\n\n        return objects;\n    }\n\n    function visitObjectLiteralExpression(node: ObjectLiteralExpression): Expression {\n        if (node.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread) {\n            // spread elements emit like so:\n            // non-spread elements are chunked together into object literals, and then all are passed to __assign:\n            //     { a, ...o, b } => __assign(__assign({a}, o), {b});\n            // If the first element is a spread element, then the first argument to __assign is {}:\n            //     { ...o, a, b, ...o2 } => __assign(__assign(__assign({}, o), {a, b}), o2)\n            //\n            // We cannot call __assign with more than two elements, since any element could cause side effects. For\n            // example:\n            //      var k = { a: 1, b: 2 };\n            //      var o = { a: 3, ...k, b: k.a++ };\n            //      // expected: { a: 1, b: 1 }\n            // If we translate the above to `__assign({ a: 3 }, k, { b: k.a++ })`, the `k.a++` will evaluate before\n            // `k` is spread and we end up with `{ a: 2, b: 1 }`.\n            //\n            // This also occurs for spread elements, not just property assignments:\n            //      var k = { a: 1, get b() { l = { z: 9 }; return 2; } };\n            //      var l = { c: 3 };\n            //      var o = { ...k, ...l };\n            //      // expected: { a: 1, b: 2, z: 9 }\n            // If we translate the above to `__assign({}, k, l)`, the `l` will evaluate before `k` is spread and we\n            // end up with `{ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 }`\n            const objects = chunkObjectLiteralElements(node.properties);\n            if (objects.length && objects[0]!.kind !== SyntaxKind.ObjectLiteralExpression) {\n                objects.unshift(factory.createObjectLiteralExpression());\n            }\n            let expression: Expression = objects[0]!;\n            if (objects.length > 1) {\n                for (let i = 1; i < objects.length; i++) {\n                    expression = emitHelpers().createAssignHelper([expression, objects[i]!]);\n                }\n                return expression;\n            }\n            else {\n                return emitHelpers().createAssignHelper(objects);\n            }\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitExpressionStatement(node: ExpressionStatement): ExpressionStatement {\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitParenthesizedExpression(node: ParenthesizedExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): ParenthesizedExpression {\n        return visitEachChild(node, expressionResultIsUnused ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitSourceFile(node: SourceFile): SourceFile {\n        const ancestorFacts = enterSubtree(\n            HierarchyFacts.SourceFileExcludes,\n            isEffectiveStrictModeSourceFile(node, compilerOptions) ?\n                HierarchyFacts.StrictModeSourceFileIncludes :\n                HierarchyFacts.SourceFileIncludes,\n        );\n        exportedVariableStatement = false;\n        const visited = visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n        const statement = concatenate(\n            visited.statements,\n            taggedTemplateStringDeclarations && [\n                factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, factory.createVariableDeclarationList(taggedTemplateStringDeclarations)),\n            ],\n        );\n        const result = factory.updateSourceFile(visited, setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(statement), node.statements));\n        exitSubtree(ancestorFacts);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function assignment.\n     *\n     * @param node A BinaryExpression node.\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitBinaryExpression(node: BinaryExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): Expression {\n        if (isDestructuringAssignment(node) && containsObjectRestOrSpread(node.left)) {\n            return flattenDestructuringAssignment(\n                node,\n                visitor,\n                context,\n                FlattenLevel.ObjectRest,\n                !expressionResultIsUnused,\n            );\n        }\n        if (node.operatorToken.kind === SyntaxKind.CommaToken) {\n    visitNode(node.right, expressionResultIsUnused ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, isExpression),\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param expressionResultIsUnused Indicates the result of an expression is unused by the parent node (i.e., the left side of a comma or the\n     * expression of an `ExpressionStatement`).\n     */\n    function visitCommaListExpression(node: CommaListExpression, expressionResultIsUnused: boolean): Expression {\n        if (expressionResultIsUnused) {\n            return visitEachChild(node, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n        }\n        let result: Expression[] | undefined;\n        for (let i = 0; i < node.elements.length; i++) {\n            const element = node.elements[i]!;\n            const visited = visitNode(element, i < node.elements.length - 1 ? visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult : visitor, isExpression);\n            if (result || visited !== element) {\n                result ||= node.elements.slice(0, i);\n                result.push(visited);\n            }\n        }\n        const elements = result ? setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(result), node.elements) : node.elements;\n        return factory.updateCommaListExpression(node, elements);\n    }\n\n    function visitCatchClause(node: TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread\n        ) {\n            const name = factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(node.variableDeclaration.name);\n            const updatedDecl = factory.updateVariableDeclaration(node.variableDeclaration, node.variableDeclaration.name, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined, name);\n            const visitedBindings =          block = factory.updateBlock(block, [\n                    factory.createVariableStatement(/*modifiers*/ undefined, visitedBindings),\n                    ...block.statements,\n visitVariableStatement(node: VariableStatement): VisitResult<VariableStatement> {\n        if (hasSyntacticModifier(node, ModifierFlags.Export)) {\n            const savedExportedVariableStatement = exportedVariableStatement;\n            exportedVariableStatement = true;\n            const visited = visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n            exportedVariableStatement = savedExportedVariableStatement;\n            return visited;\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Visits a VariableDeclaration node with a binding pattern.\n     *\n     * @param node A VariableDeclaration node.\n     */\n    function visitVariableDeclaration(node: VariableDeclaration): VisitResult<VariableDeclaration> {\n        if visitVariableDeclarationWorker(node, /*exportedVariableStatement*/ true);\n            exportedVariableStatement = savedExportedVariableStatement;\n            return visited;\n        }\n node.name.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread) {\n            return flattenDestructuringBinding(\n                node,\n                visitor,\n                context,\n                FlattenLevel.ObjectRest,\n                /*rval*/ undefined,\n                exportedVariableStatement,\n            );\n        }\n        return visitEachChild(node, visitor, context);\n    }\n\n    function visitForStatement(node: ForStatement): VisitResult<Statement> {\n        return factory.updateForStatement(\n            node,\n            visitNode(node.initializer, visitorWithUnusedExpressionResult, context);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Visits a ForOfStatement and converts it into a ES2015-compatible ForOfStatement.\n     *\n     * @param node A ForOfStatement.\n     */\n    function visitForOfStatement(node: ForOfStatement, outermostLabeledStatement: LabeledStatement | undefined): VisitResult<Statement> {\n        const ancestorFacts = enterSubtree(HierarchyFacts.IterationStatementExcludes, HierarchyFacts.IterationStatementIncludes);\n        if (\n            node.initializer.transformFlags & TransformFlags.ContainsObjectRestOrSpread ||\n            isAssignmentPattern(node.initializer) && containsObjectRestOrSpread(node.initializer)\n        ) {\n            node = transformForOfStatementWithObjectRest(node);\n        }\n        const result = node.awaitModifier ?\n            transformForAwaitOfStatement(node, outermostLabeledStatement, ancestorFacts) :\n            factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(visitEachChild(node, visitor, context), outermostLabeledStatement);\n        exitSubtree(ancestorFacts);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function transformForOfStatementWithObjectRest(node: ForOfStatement) {\n        const initializerWithoutParens = skipParentheses(node.initializer) as ForInitializer;\n        if (isVariableDeclarationList(initializerWithoutParens) || isAssignmentPattern(initializerWithoutParens)) {\n            let bodyLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n            let statementsLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n            const temp = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n            const statements: Statement[] = [createForOfBindingStatement(factory, initializerWithoutParens, temp)];\n            if (isBlock(node.statement)) {\n                addRange(statements, node.statement.statements);\n                bodyLocation = node.statement;\n                statementsLocation = node.statement.statements;\n            }\n            else if (node.statement) {\n                append(statements, node.statement);\n                bodyLocation = node.statement;\n                statementsLocation = node.statement;\n            }\n            return factory.updateForOfStatement(\n                node,\n                node.awaitModifier,\n                setTextRange(\n                    factory.createVariableDeclarationList(\n                        [\n                            setTextRange(factory.createVariableDeclaration(temp),           /*multiLine*/ true,\n                    ),\n                    bodyLocation,\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n        return node;\n    }\n\n    function convertForOfStatementHead(node: ForOfStatement, boundValue: Expression, nonUserCode: Identifier) {\n        const value = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n        const iteratorValueExpression = factory.createAssignment(value, boundValue);\n        const iteratorValueStatement = factory.createExpressionStatement(iteratorValueExpression);\n        setSourceMapRange(iteratorValueStatement, node.expression);\n\n        const exitNonUserCodeExpression = factory.createAssignment(nonUserCode, factory.createFalse());\n        const exitNonUserCodeStatement = factory.createExpressionStatement(exitNonUserCodeExpression);\n        setSourceMapRange(exitNonUserCodeStatement, node.expression);\n\n        const statements: Statement[] = [iteratorValueStatement, exitNonUserCodeStatement];\n        const binding = createForOfBindingStatement(factory, node.initializer, value);\n        statements.push(visitNode(binding, visitor, isStatement));\n\n        let bodyLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n        let statementsLocation: TextRange | undefined;\n        const statement = visitIterationBody(node.statement, visitor, context);\n        if (isBlock(statement)) {\n            addRange(statements, statement.statements);\n            bodyLocation = statement;\n            statementsLocation = statement.statements;\n        }\n        else {\n            statements.push(statement);\n        }\n\n        return setTextRange(\n            factory.createBlock(\n                setTextRange(factory.createNodeArray(statements), statementsLocation),\n                /*multiLine*/ true,\n            ),\n            bodyLocation,\n        );\n    }\n\n    function createDownlevelAwait(expression: Expression) {\n        return enclosingFunctionFlags & FunctionFlags.Generator\n            ? factory.createYieldExpression(/*asteriskToken*/ undefined, emitHelpers().createAwaitHelper(expression))\n            : factory.createAwaitExpression(expression);\n    }\n\n    function transformForAwaitOfStatement(node: ForOfStatement, outermostLabeledStatement: LabeledStatement | undefined, ancestorFacts: HierarchyFacts) {\n        const expression = visitNode(node.expression, visitor, isExpression);\n        const iterator = isIdentifier(expression) ? factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(expression) : factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const result = isIdentifier(expression) ? factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(iterator) : factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const nonUserCode = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const done = factory.createTempVariable(hoistVariableDeclaration);\n        const errorRecord = factory.createUniqueName(\"e\");\n        const catchVariable = factory.getGeneratedNameForNode(errorRecord);\n        const returnMethod = factory.createTempVariable(/*recordTempVariable*/ undefined);\n        const callValues = setTextRange(emitHelpers().createAsyncValuesHelper(expression), node.expression);\n        const callNext = factory.createCallExpression(factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(iterator, \"next\"), /*typeArguments*/ undefined, []);\n        const getDone = factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(result, \"done\");\n        const getValue = factory.createPropertyAccessExpression(result, \"value\");\n        const callReturn = factory.createFunctionCallCall(returnMethod, iterator, []);\n\n        hoistVariableDeclaration(errorRecord);\n        hoistVariableDeclaration(returnMethod);\n\n        // if we are enclosed in an outer loop ensure we reset 'errorRecord' per each iteration\n        const initializer = ancestorFacts & HierarchyFacts.IterationContainer ?\n            factory.inlineExpressions([factory.createAssignment(errorRecord, factory.createVoidZero()), callValues]) :\n            callValues;\n\n        const forStatement = setEmitFlags(\n            setTextRange(\n                factory.createForStatement(\n                    /*initializer*/ setEmitFlags(\n                        setTextRange(\n                            factory.createVariableDeclarationList([\n                                factory.createVariableDeclaration(nonUserCode, /*exclamationToken*/ undefined, /*type*/ undefined,                              factory.createVariableDeclaration(result),\n                            ]),\n                            node.expression,\n                        ),\n                        EmitFlags.NoHoisting,\n                    ),\n                    /*condition*/ factory.inlineExpressions([\n                        factory.createAssignment(result, createDownlevelAwait(callNext)),\n                        factory.createAssignment(done, getDone),\n                        factory.createLogicalNot(done),\n                    ]),\n                    /*incrementor*/ factory.createAssignment(nonUserCode, factory.createTrue()),\n                    /*statement*/ convertForOfStatementHead(node, getValue, nonUserCode),\n                ),\n                /*location*/ node,\n            ),\n            EmitFlags.NoTokenTrailingSourceMaps,\n        );\n        setOriginalNode(forStatement, node);\n\n        return factory.createTryStatement(\n            factory.createBlock([\n                factory.restoreEnclosingLabel(\n                    forStatement,\n                    outermostLabeledStatement,\n                ),\n            ]),\n            factory.createCatchClause(\n                factory.createVariableDeclaration(catchVariable),\n                setEmitFlags(\n                    factory.createBlock([\n   ),\n                        ),\n                    ]),\n                    EmitFlags.SingleLine,\n                ),\n            ),\n            factory.createBlock([\n
